          What is a No Annual Fee Credit Card?

          A no annual fee credit card offers the convenience and flexibility of a credit card without the yearly cost—an ideal option if you want to build your credit history without paying an extra fee. Many no annual fee cards still offer perks like purchase protection, extended warranty coverage or a rewards program for eligible purchases. Used wisely and paid on time, no yearly fee credit cards are an affordable way to keep your credit active and manage expenses.

          Choosing the No Annual Fee Credit Card That Best Meets Your Needs

          Understanding no annual fee

          For no annual fee credit cards, the annual fee is $0. This means there’s no annual fees to pay upfront or worry about later. However, other fees like transaction fees, cash advance fees, including balance transfer fees, or interest charges may still apply.

          Different types of credit cards

          No annual fee credit cards come with different ways to earn. Points based rewards cards let you earn points that can be used on things like groceries, dining, gas, travel and more. Cash back cards let you earn a cash back credit for a percentage of the purchase.

          Who are no annual fee credit cards best for

          No annual fee credit cards are a great option for individuals who are new to credit cards, have limited spending, prefer to avoid ongoing fees, or don't require extensive rewards. These cards can help establish a credit history and offer rewards and other partner benefits.
